metadata.scenario: A patient calls to praise the new wound care nurse who visited yesterday. She says the nurse was thorough and the wound is already looking better. She asks if the same nurse can be assigned going forward. Very positive, grateful tone.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I wanted to share some positive feedback. Hi Helen! It's great to hear from you. What’s on your mind? I had a visit from the new wound care nurse yesterday, and I just have to say she was fantastic! That’s wonderful to hear! What did you like most about her visit? She was very thorough and gentle, and I really appreciated how she explained everything to me. I’m so glad she made you feel comfortable. It’s important that our clients are well-informed. Yes, and the wound is already looking better today. I can’t thank you enough! That’s fantastic news, Helen! We always aim for the best outcomes. Can we have her assigned to me going forward? I’d really prefer her for my future visits. Absolutely, I can request that. May I have her name to ensure we get it right? I didn’t catch her name, but she mentioned she was new to the team. No worries, I’ll check our records for the nurse who covered your wound care. Thank you! I really appreciate it. It’s my pleasure! I’ll make sure to follow up on that today. Also, I was wondering if you offer any additional services for mobility assistance, too? Yes, we do offer services like physical therapy and personal care assistance. Oh, that sounds like something I might need. Can you tell me more about those? Sure! Physical therapy sessions are $110 to $140 per visit, focusing on mobility and strength. That sounds reasonable. I might be interested in scheduling a session. Great! I can set that up for you. Would you like me to get a care coordinator to assist with that? Yes, please. That would be very helpful. Perfect, I’ll connect you with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator. Thank you so much, Margaret. I really appreciate your help today! You’re very welcome, Helen! I’ll ensure everything is taken care of. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
